# Angular Routing Specialist Skill

> **Category:** Tech Skills > Frontend > Angular

## Overview

Implements complex Angular routing strategies including lazy loading, route guards, resolvers, and nested routing configurations

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [angular-routing-specialist-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
angular-routing-specialist-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@angular-routing-specialist` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Configure lazy-loaded feature modules with loadChildren
- Implement CanActivate, CanDeactivate, and Resolve guards
- Design nested routing hierarchies with named outlets
- Set up preloading strategies for optimal performance

## Technology Standards Applied

- **Angular Router**: Official routing patterns and lazy loading best practices
- **Route Guard Patterns**: Authentication and authorization guard implementations
- **Performance**: Preloading strategies and bundle size optimization
